summary: Light verification of vercel.json fix + regression smoke. vercel.json is valid JSON with correct SPA config. Production build (CI=true yarn build) completed successfully with 'Compiled successfully.' — no ESLint warnings-as-errors, exit 0, ~17s. Frontend home renders featured-grid and popular-cities-grid; header-admin-link navigates to /admin; admin login (admin/admin123) reaches /admin/dashboard. Backend /api/courses and /api/content OK. Note: current DB has 149 courses & 2 featured (not 151/3 as stated in request) — this is DB drift from prior admin edits, not caused by the vercel.json change; seeding is empty-DB-only.
action_items: Optional: Verify expected featured/course counts. Request stated 151 courses / 3 featured, actual is 149 / 2. If those specific numbers matter, reseed DB or make seed idempotent-refresh. Otherwise no action needed — vercel.json fix is correct and complete.
critical_code_review_comments: vercel.json rewrite regex '/((?!api/).*)' correctly excludes /api/* from SPA fallback so Vercel will forward /api routes to a separate backend if configured; this is client-side rewrites only — user must still deploy FastAPI backend separately (Vercel Serverless or external) and set REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL to it at build time.
seed_admin/course seeding only runs when DB collections are empty, causing count drift over time as data is edited/deleted through admin panel.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_1 already covered full CRUD (23/23). This iteration verified only the vercel.json deployment fix + light regression. Actual Vercel deployment cannot be verified from this environment.
